privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: MentorAura collects information you provide directly when registering as a Mentee or Mentor, including your name, email address, professional history, skills, payment details, and communication logs on the platform.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to match mentees with verified mentors, facilitate 1-on-1 scheduling, process escrow payments and mentor payouts, send transactional notifications, and ensure platform safety.
privacy.s3Body: All sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Payment credentials are handled through certified payment processors and are never stored in plain text on MentorAura servers.
privacy.s4Body: If you have questions regarding your privacy or data rights, please contact us at privacy@mentoraura.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or using MentorAura, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service and our community guidelines.
terms.s2Body: Payments for mentorship plans and 1-on-1 sessions are held securely in escrow. Funds are released to mentors upon successful completion of scheduled sessions in accordance with our payout policy.
terms.s3Body: Sessions may be rescheduled or cancelled with at least 24 hours notice. In the event of a dispute, either party may submit a dispute report for review by MentorAura administrators.
terms.s4Body: Mentors and mentees must maintain professional, respectful communication at all times. Harassment, fraud, or off-platform payment solicitation will result in immediate account termination.
